BORDJ BOU ARRERIDJ, 28 juil 2026 (Algeri: BORDJ BOU ARRERIDJ, July 28, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The Minister of Foreign Trade launched on Tuesday several export operations of Algerian air conditioners and refrigerators to Spain, Tunisia, Libya and Mauritania. These initiatives are part of the national strategy for diversifying non-hydrocarbon exports.
Lancement d'exportations massives vers l: Launch of massive exports to Europe and the Maghreb
Le ministre du Commerce extérieur et de: The Minister of Foreign Trade and Export Promotion, Kamel Rezig, accompanied by the wali of Bordj Bou Arréridj, Kamel Nouicer, supervised on July 28, 2026 the launch of several export operations of household appliances manufactured in Algeria. The first of these concerns the shipment of mobile air conditioners of the Condor brand to Spain, responding to a commercial order from the main European purchasing centers for this type of product.
Parallèlement, des climatiseurs fixes de: At the same time, “Split” type stationary air conditioners were exported to Tunisia as part of a load of 46 containers. A convoy of 14 containers of Midea brand refrigerators and freezers also left Bordj Bou Arréridj bound for Tunisia, Libya and Mauritania.
Une dynamique exportatrice saluée par le: An export dynamic praised by international operators
Dans une déclaration à la presse, Kamel: In a statement to the press, Kamel Rezig stressed that these operations “materialize the results of the economic policy driven by the President of the Republic, Mr. Abdelmadjid Tebboune.” He specified that more than 250,000 Condor mobile air conditioners have already been ordered for export, confirming “the potential of the Algerian product on the European market”.
Le ministre a mis en avant la conformité: The minister highlighted the compliance of Algerian products with European standards in terms of quality, safety and performance, describing this breakthrough as "a strong signal" demonstrating the capacity of Algerian industry to access the most demanding international markets. He also mentioned the geographical proximity to Europe, allowing maritime delivery in just two days, a competitive advantage reducing logistics costs and improving the responsiveness of exporters.
En marge de cette visite, Kamel Rezig a: On the sidelines of this visit, Kamel Rezig inspected the railway terminal recently commissioned at the Bordj Bou Arréridj industrial zone. Dedicated to the consolidation of containers intended for export as well as the reception and unloading of goods, this infrastructure aims to improve the logistics chain, reduce transport times and costs, and strengthen the group's export capabilities.

Le directeur général adjoint du groupe C: The deputy general director of the Condor group, Mohamed Salah Daâs, confirmed that the company meets all the technical and commercial requirements of European purchasing centers. He indicated that this first export to Spain marks the start of a development program including the conclusion of new technological partnerships with international operators.
